declarations.description:
Attaches related buttons into one control: shared borders, outside corners only, a divider between items. Children
are `c2-button` or `c2-icon-button` elements (any element works for layout). With `selection="single"` the group is
a segmented control that keeps one item pressed; with `selection="multiple"` each item toggles independently. Set
`orientation="vertical"` to stack either appearance and use Up/Down keyboard navigation. The
pressed items carry `selected` (and `aria-pressed`), the group reports them in `value` and fires `change`.
declarations.name: ButtonGroup

cssProperties.description: Space between items. Zero attaches them; a positive gap separates them into individually rounded buttons.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--gap

cssProperties.description: Outside corner radius. With a positive gap, applies to every item.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Border applied to every item, e.g. `1px solid #d4d4d8` for an outlined group.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--border

cssProperties.description: Width of the line between attached items; also how much their borders overlap.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__divider--width

cssProperties.description: Colour of the line between attached items. Match the border colour for outlined groups, `transparent` for none.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__divider--color

cssProperties.description: `1 1 0` makes every item grow to the same width.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__item--flex

cssProperties.description: Track background in the segmented appearance.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__segmented--background-color

cssProperties.description: Track border in the segmented appearance.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__segmented--border

cssProperties.description: Sliding selection indicator animation duration. In the segmented appearance the group owns its children's surface variables with an important cascade layer. Theme the control through the `segmented-*` and `indicator-*` variables above; app-wide `c2-button` defaults will not leak into the segmented surface.
cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__indicator--transition-duration

members.name: selection
members.description: `none` (default) for plain attached buttons, `single` for one pressed item, `multiple` for independent toggles.

members.name: value
members.description: `value` of the pressed item; comma-separated values with `selection="multiple"`. Items without a `value` attribute use their index.

members.name: appearance
members.description: `segmented` adds an inset track and sliding selected surface and always uses single selection.

members.name: stretched
members.description: Makes the group and every item share the available width.

events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the new `value`. Not fired for programmatic changes.
events.name: change
